title: 第十七章 师尊别这样
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
“招蜂引蝶坠”。

    听名字就不像什么正经物件。

    但季南北拿到手里，却并未察觉到什么异常，反而感觉周遭的灵气正自发向他涌来。

    就如同寻常的修炼法宝一般，能自动汇聚天地灵气，供主人吸纳。

    “咦?难道这破系统转性了?这回给的是个正经法宝?”

    季南北心下纳闷。

    他轻轻晃了晃手中的玉坠，只见玉蝶在环内翩然摇曳，做工确实精巧，十分好看。

    “暂且信你一回。”

    季南北随手将玉坠系在腰间。这类辅助修炼的法宝，本就需贴身佩戴，方能牵引周围灵气，加速修行。

    一身黑色短打外袍，配上这枚精致的玉坠，此刻的季南北倒真有几分世家公子的气度。

    加之先前洗经伐髓，祛除杂质，他的肌肤更显莹润通透。

    原本就堪称“少女杀手、少妇之友”的相貌，如今更是提升了一截，将“小白脸”三个字演绎到了极致。

    望着湖面中自己的倒影，季南北点了点头。

    “嗯，爷这模样，确实挺标致。”

    就在这时，远处忽然传来隐约的水声。

    季南北表情顿时变得微妙起来。

    这......莫非......

    是传说中的福利环节?

    【触发任务，请从以下选项中择一执行。】

    选项一、“让我看看!让我看看你发育得正不正常!”上前察看，并作出评价。(奖励:魔道点五十万，五品灵宝碎月锤。)

    选项二、“光听水声就够下三碗饭了!”原地倾听，自得其乐。(奖励:魔道点三十万，四品灵宝不灭之握。)

    选项三、“非礼勿视，非礼勿听。”在原地静候。(奖励:魔道点三千，随机三品符篆一张。)

    季南北简直想骂人。

    既然系统任务已经弹出，那远处的水声，自然只能是有人在泡澡。

    而且按照系统的任务猜想，这洗澡的九成应该还是个妹子。

    只不过这座快活林魔宗驻扎的山上，除了他那性子恶劣的师姐，便只有终日闭关、酒壶不离手的师尊了。

    季南北推测，那边洗澡的多半就是师姐了。

    以师姐的修为和脾气，自己若是靠近，即便隐藏得再好，也极可能被发现。

    更何况还得当面品头论足?

    师姐就算不取他性命，起码也得落个半身不遂、终身瘫痪。

    换句话说，他四分之三的身体控制权恐怕就得交代在这儿。
content_en:
"Attracting bees and butterflies."

    The name doesn't sound like a serious object.

    But when Ji Nanbei took it in his hand, he didn't notice anything unusual. Instead, he felt that the spiritual energy around him was spontaneously flowing towards him.

    Just like an ordinary cultivation magic weapon, it can automatically gather the spiritual energy of heaven and earth for the master to absorb.

    "Huh? Has this broken system changed its gender? Is it a serious magic weapon this time?"

    Ji Nanbei was puzzled.

    He gently shook the jade pendant in his hand and saw jade butterflies swaying gracefully in the ring. It was indeed exquisitely made and very beautiful.

    "I'll believe you for now."

    Ji Nanbei casually tied the jade pendant around his waist. This kind of magic weapon that assists cultivation needs to be worn close to the body in order to attract the surrounding spiritual energy and accelerate cultivation.

    Dressed in a short black robe and paired with this exquisite jade pendant, Ji Nanbei looked a bit like a young man from an aristocratic family at this moment.

    Coupled with the previous menstrual cleansing and marrow removal to remove impurities, his skin became more radiant and translucent.

    The appearance that was originally called "girl killer, young woman's friend" has now been improved even more, taking the word "pretty face" to the extreme.

    Looking at his reflection in the lake, Ji Nanbei nodded.

    "Well, I look really handsome like this."

    At this moment, the faint sound of water suddenly came from the distance.

    Ji Nanbei's expression suddenly became subtle.

    This...could it be...

    Is it the legendary welfare link?

    [To trigger the task, please choose one of the following options to execute. 】

    Option 1: "Let me see! Let me see if you are developing normally!" Come forward to observe and make an evaluation. (Reward: 500,000 magic points, fifth-grade spiritual treasure moon-shattering hammer.)

    Option 2: "Just listening to the sound of water is enough to make three bowls of rice!" Just listen and enjoy yourself. (Reward: 300,000 magic points, the immortal grasp of the fourth-grade spiritual treasure.)

    Option three: "See no evil and hear no evil." Wait quietly where you are. (Reward: 3,000 magic points and a random third-grade talisman seal.)

    Ji Nanbei just wanted to curse.

    Now that the system task has popped up, the sound of water in the distance can only be someone taking a bath.

    And according to the system's mission guess, 90% of the people taking a bath should still be a girl.

    It's just that on this mountain where the Happy Forest Demon Sect is stationed, apart from his ill-tempered senior sister, there is only a master who is in seclusion all day long and never leaves his hand with the wine bottle.

    Ji Nanbei speculated that most of the people taking a bath there were senior sisters.

    With senior sister's cultivation and temper, if she gets close, no matter how well she hides, she will most likely be discovered.

    What's more, we have to judge him face to face?

    Even if the senior sister doesn't take his life, she will at least become hemiplegic and paralyzed for life.

    In other words, three-quarters of his body control may have to be handed over here.
title_en: Chapter 17 Master, don’t be like this
